task.objective: Triage security alert INC-4271 on a local test web service: determine the true nature of the anomalous activity (a specific attack, a misconfiguration, an authorized activity, or a false positive)
task.initial_observation: Alert: spike in authentication failures and 4xx/5xx errors on the web tier over the last hour

answer_options.credential_stuffing: A real credential-stuffing attack: distributed failed logins across many accounts from many source IPs.
answer_options.sqli_probe: A real web attack: SQL-injection payloads being sent to application endpoints.
answer_options.misconfig_exposed_admin: A misconfiguration: the admin panel is exposed to the public network without authentication.
answer_options.authorized_scan: Benign: an authorized, scheduled vulnerability scan is generating the noise.
answer_options.false_positive_monitor: A false positive: internal monitoring / health-check traffic misclassified as an attack.
answer_options.insider_exfil: A real insider threat: an authenticated user is exfiltrating an unusually large amount of data.
answer_options.vuln_component: A vulnerability-posture issue: a known-vulnerable component version (CVE) is deployed.
answer_options.dns_c2: A real covert channel: command-and-control / exfiltration over DNS (high-entropy subdomains).

task.finish_rule: Cite 1-3 observation IDs from the current state version whose response directly shows the cause.
